title: Polylean Unit Conjecture Counterexample
abstract: Formalizes Gardam's counterexample to Kaplansky's Unit Conjecture, including the Promislow group, group rings, torsion-freeness of the group, and the non-trivial unit in 𝔽₂[P].

informal.LeanPool.Polylean.P.torsionFree: Proves that the Promislow group used in Gardam's construction is torsion-free.
informal.LeanPool.Polylean.Gardam.GardamTheorem: Proves Gardam's counterexample to Kaplansky's Unit Conjecture by constructing a non-trivial unit in the group ring 𝔽₂[P].
